materialFinding.originalIssue: Twenty legal 16-character names were joined into the backup confirmation, placing restore/retain buttons below the 1180x720 viewport.
materialFinding.evidence: The original disposable-browser reproduction found document height 843px, restore button bottom 824.9px and retain button bottom 818px in Chromium and WebKit.
materialFinding.resolution: Parent agent replaced the joined preview with explicit two-profile pages and fixed actions; final application backup/safe-area cases are checked in the independent iPad test report.

runner.reproduce: Extract runner.source to an .mjs file, then run node <file> with project root as cwd; uses project esbuild and Playwright plus installed Chrome. All browser contexts and profiles are disposable. The route supplies a local fixture, so no live app server is required.
